rules.title: Security deposit cap – one month's rent (most landlords)
rules.quote: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.summary: Most landlords in California may charge no more than one month's rent as a security deposit for both furnished and unfurnished units.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.exemption_note: Small landlords (owning 2 properties with ≤4 units total, natural person/family trust/LLC of natural persons) may charge up to 2 months' rent

rules.title: Security deposit cap – two months' rent (small landlords)
rules.quote: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons
rules.summary: Small landlords who own only two rental properties with a total of four or fewer units, held by natural persons, family trusts, or LLCs of natural persons, may charge up to two months' rent as a security deposit.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent
rules.coverage_text: landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total

rules.title: Landlord must photograph unit before or at start of new tenancy
rules.quote: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document the condition of the unit.
rules.summary: Landlords must photograph the rental unit immediately before or at the start of any new tenancy beginning on or after July 1, 2025, to document its condition.
rules.effective_date_evidence: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy

rules.title: Security deposit return within 21 days with itemization
rules.quote: All or any remaining portion of a security deposit must be returned within 21 days after the tenant/s leave the unit vacant. If deductions were made, the landlord must give the tenant a written statement itemizing the amount of and and purpose for any security deposit deductions, accompanied by copies of documents showing charges incurred and deducted by the landlord to repair or clean the premises.
rules.summary: Landlords must return any remaining security deposit within 21 days after the tenant vacates, along with an itemized statement and supporting documents if any deductions were made.

rules.title: Landlord must provide proof repairs were completed
rules.quote: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.
rules.summary: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that any necessary repairs for which they made security deposit deductions were actually completed.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.

rules.title: Landlord must photograph unit after possession before repairs
rules.quote: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit. These photos and a written explanation of the cost of the repairs/cleaning must be given to the tenant along with the itemized statement.
rules.summary: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must photograph the unit after the tenant moves out but before making any repairs or cleaning they intend to charge for, and provide those photos with a written cost explanation to the tenant.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit.

rules.title: Security deposit interest required for covered units
rules.quote: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.summary: Landlords of rent-controlled units in Berkeley must pay tenants interest on their security deposits annually and on a prorated basis upon move-out.
rules.coverage_text: units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
rules.exemption_note: Only applies to units covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance
